guidance.summary: Conservative mobile business units for FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: Please appreciate on a conservative basis, the steps that we are taking for growth and consolidation in the mobile business for us, we should be even a conservative basis, somewhere around 60 million, 65 million units.

guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business.

guidance.summary: Motorola export revenue for current fiscal
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel we should be closing at almost INR5,500 crores, INR6,000 crores in the current fiscal.

guidance.summary: Telecom business revenue for the year
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: This year, we should have revenues close to INR5,200 crores.

guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: And we feel that in the overall fiscal, it should be somewhere between INR1,100 crores, INR1,200 crores.

guidance.summary: IT hardware revenue for current year
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: So this year, we feel the revenue should be in the range of INR1,500-odd crores.

guidance.summary: IT hardware revenue for next year
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel that for next year, the numbers are going to be somewhere around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.
